title: Lumaril Launches Industrial Autonomy Platform to Scale US Manufacturing Output
summary:
A new venture backed by investor Elad Gil and Lux Capital is deploying artificial intelligence to help American plants run at higher capacity by digitizing the tacit knowledge of veteran workers. The startup, which launched on Oct. 27, targets hundreds of thousands of existing US manufacturing facilities to prevent production losses as senior operators retire and take unwritten operational expertise with them.

Lumaril raised a Series A funding round led by Gil and was founded by a team of former employees from the data analytics firm Palantir. The company intends to use industrial autonomy to restore domestic capacity and scale the growth of existing businesses rather than relying solely on the construction of new factories.

selectedTweets.text:
Today we’re launching Lumaril.

We’re an industrial autonomy company helping America’s existing factories run at their true capacity, with more production and less waste.

The US is home to hundreds of thousands of plants, run by senior operators with decades of tacit knowledge. Much of it is unwritten, and a growing wave of retirements is taking it out the door.

If we let these facilities go dark, we don't just lose great companies and the towns that depend on them. We lose the living blueprints for making the goods and materials this country can’t afford to do without.

Reindustrialization won’t come from new factories alone. The plants we already have are great American businesses, built over generations, with enormous potential to grow. We believe helping them scale is the fastest path to restoring industrial capacity.
